descriptionHtml: An introductory session to the project in radio astronomy was held at Engineering Workshop from 11.00 am - 12.00 pm. The Undergraduates who are currently involved in this project with the guidance of Senior Lecturer Dr. Aruna Gunawardhane gave a good idea on the progress of the project to the newbies and introduced them with the challenges ahead. The undergraduates who were willing to take part in this project were induced on that day and will be guided and monitored properly.
venue: Engineering Workshop, Department of Electrical and Electrical Engineering
